value.rationale: This is the natural sharp support-minimizer problem for the foundational first five-by-five chessboard 3-torsion complex, with all 1800 minimizing supports, a single orbit, and a nontrivial two-class pair-incidence profile. Numerical homology alone cannot give these carriers; the exact classification is a substantive and reusable finite topological invariant.
